Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293258. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1293258, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
